summary: TSTVAL00 is a batch Test Validation Suite. It reads a file of test cases, and for each dispatches on the test type (FUNCTIONAL / INTEGRATE / PERFORM / ERROR), runs the test, validates the actual result against the expected result, updates pass/fail metrics, and writes a per-test detail line to a report. At the end it writes a summary (total/passed/failed and a success-rate percent) and closes files. NOTE: the actual test-running and validation sub-paragraphs (2200-2800) are referenced by the dispatcher but are NOT defined in the source — this is a harness skeleton whose test bodies are not yet implemented.

paragraphs.name: 1100-OPEN-FILES
paragraphs.pseudocode:
OPEN INPUT TEST-CASES; IF status<>'00' -> error handler
OPEN INPUT EXPECTED-RESULTS; IF status<>'00' -> error handler
OPEN INPUT ACTUAL-RESULTS; IF status<>'00' -> error handler
OPEN OUTPUT TEST-REPORT; IF status<>'00' -> error handler

paragraphs.name: 1200-WRITE-HEADERS
paragraphs.pseudocode:
WRITE report header line 1 (all '*')
WRITE report header line 2 ('TEST VALIDATION REPORT')

paragraphs.name: 1300-INIT-METRICS
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CLEAR WS-TEST-METRICS
ACCEPT WS-START-TIME FROM system TIME

paragraphs.name: 2000-PROCESS
paragraphs.pseudocode:
WHILE NOT end of tests DO
  READ TEST-CASES
  IF at end THEN SET END-OF-TESTS ELSE CALL 2100-EXECUTE-TEST
END WHILE
CALL 2900-WRITE-SUMMARY
branches: READ ... AT END / NOT AT END

paragraphs.name: 2100-EXECUTE-TEST
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SELECT CASE test type
  WHEN 'FUNCTIONAL': CALL 2200-RUN-FUNCTIONAL-TEST
  WHEN 'INTEGRATE':  CALL 2300-RUN-INTEGRATION-TEST
  WHEN 'PERFORM':    CALL 2400-RUN-PERFORMANCE-TEST
  WHEN 'ERROR':      CALL 2500-RUN-ERROR-TEST
  ELSE: SET 'INVALID TEST TYPE'; CALL 9999-ERROR-HANDLER
END SELECT
CALL 2600-VALIDATE-RESULTS
CALL 2700-UPDATE-METRICS
CALL 2800-WRITE-TEST-DETAIL

annotations.note: SME REVIEW: none of 2200/2300/2400/2500/2600/2700/2800 are defined in the source — the test bodies, result validation and metric updates are unimplemented stubs. The suite runs but validates nothing.

paragraphs.name: 2900-WRITE-SUMMARY
paragraphs.pseudocode:
ACCEPT WS-END-TIME FROM TIME; COMPUTE elapsed = end - start
Move totals to output fields
COMPUTE success rate = (passed / total) * 100
WRITE the summary line

annotations.note: SME REVIEW: divides by WS-TOTAL-TESTS with no zero-check — if the test-case file is empty (0 tests), this is a divide-by-zero at runtime.

paragraphs.name: 9999-ERROR-HANDLER
paragraphs.pseudocode:
DISPLAY WS-ERROR-MESSAGE on the console
SET RETURN-CODE = 12
RETURN (GOBACK)

annotations.note: Any error aborts the whole suite (GOBACK with rc=12), even a single bad test type.
